id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Gaaah...!
"Impossible... That I... that I would lose...!!

"...If I fall here, I'll have
  no face to show him!

{var:1} knocked away Jasper's attack
with the Sword of Shadows!

But the shock shattered
the Sword of Shadows!
"Ngh...
"These fragments...

"I followed Jasper here, and this...
  What on earth happened?

"I followed Jasper here, and this...
  What on earth happened?
"What happened in this place...

"Hendrik, look upon this man.
  A general of Heliodor who wore a mask
  while selling his soul to monsters.

"Hendrik, listen! The monsters' pawn
  working in the shadows wasn't {var:1}.
  It was Jasper!
"Ugh... Urgh...

"...So it was true.
  Jasper... a man like you,
  why would you turn to monsters...
"Please, spare me...

"A pawn of the Devil, who deceived
  the people and disturbed the world.
  Atone with your death.

"Hendrik. You did well to see through Jasper
  and bring me here.

"Without you, I'd still be swayed
  by Jasper's smooth words, lending a hand
  to the monsters' schemes.

"Your words honor me...
  I'm glad we stopped Jasper's madness
  beforehand.

"{var:1}...
  Please forgive me for all I've done.

"Jasper had convinced me all along
  that the Luminary summoned monsters:
  the Devil's Child.
"...Father.

"Oh... Jade! Thank goodness you're safe.
  Don't stand there, let me see your face.

"Rab.
  I put you through hardship too...

"Dundrasil was a pity, but from now on
  let us join forces and rebuild.

"...That matters, but first we must defeat
  Mordegon, who destroyed Dundrasil
  sixteen years ago.

"Hmm... Jasper was likely
  Mordegon's pawn as well.

"{var:1}, you heard the story.
  Mordegon, the root of it all, must still
  be lurking somewhere in the world.

"Now, Luminary {var:1}!
  Take the Sword of Light that dwells in
  the Tree's soul!
